text: 中国财政部发行3年期债券，规模1200亿元，发行利率1.2200%，边际利率1.2400%，预期1.2500%，投标倍数3.07倍，边际倍数2.55倍； 中国财政部发行10年期债券，规模800亿元，发行利率1.5600%，边际利率1.5800%，预期1.5800%，投标倍数4.32倍，边际倍数1.78倍。
text_en: China's Ministry of Finance issued 3-year bonds with a size of 120 billion yuan, an issuance rate of 1.2200%, a marginal rate of 1.2400%, against an expected 1.2500%, with a bid-to-cover ratio of 3.07 times and a marginal ratio of 2.55 times; China's Ministry of Finance issued 10-year bonds with a size of 80 billion yuan, an issuance rate of 1.5600%, a marginal rate of 1.5800%, against an expected 1.5800%, with a bid-to-cover ratio of 4.32 times and a marginal ratio of 1.78 times.
